node.title: Re^3: Can not link to "id" in shortcuts (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You've linked to the HTML 5 spec, which [https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/browsers.html#the-indicated-part-of-the-document|says] that using the name attribute is a fallback when there is no such id in the document. PerlMonks is definitely not HTML 5 compliant, if you look at the source you'll see (and even so it fails validation badly), so have a look at [https://www.w3.org/TR/1999/REC-html401-19991224/struct/links.html#h-12.2|the HTML 4.01 spec]. Plus, the [id://674668] isn't even "real" HTML (, , etc.). has been the standard way to create an anchor as far back as [https://www.w3.org/MarkUp/html-spec/html-spec_7.html#SEC7.4|HTML 2.0] [https://www.w3.org/History/19921103-hypertext/hypertext/WWW/MarkUp/Tags.html#4|HTML 1.0], so don't expect browsers to remove support for it anytime soon.

Sorry for the impromptu lesson on HTML ;-P

Update: I didn't see [shmem]'s post before I posted.

Update 2: is additionally discussed in the HTML 5 spec in the section "[https://www.w3.org/TR/html5/obsolete.html#obsolete-but-conforming-features|Obsolete but conforming features]".
